conclusion.why_this_token_is_earned: an explicit producer function, transition and durable canonical write path were traced end to end from source, and the write is gated on a committed Appraisal with an exactly-once law
conclusion.why_the_second_token_is_not_earned: there is no dedicated adaptation adapter fed from episode refs for affect, in the way belief (BeliefAdaptationWiringV0) and relationship (runLivedEvidenceRelationshipFamiliarity) have one. correction_to_the_prior_audit.how_it_was_wrong: it inferred 'not wired to turns' from two export-surface facts: the executor is instantiated only inside its own module, and an existing test asserts it is not exported from the runtime index. Both are true and neither implies the executor is not invoked per turn. The executor is constructed by the session authority (line 402) and driven by the turn lifecycle.
correction_to_the_prior_audit.law: a module-boundary or export-surface fact is not a wiring fact

scope_note: affect remains OUT of Phase 0's scope. No affect value was read as an endpoint, no affect wiring was touched, and this audit changes no scientific result. It corrects a factual claim about the production architecture.
